# Centre data export: data dictionary

<!-- GENERATED by `node tests/gen-export-dictionary.js` from assets/js/org-export-core.js. Do not edit by hand: tests/org-export-core.test.js fails when this file is out of date. -->

Promise (owner's wording): **Self-service export of all records (CSV, owner only, excludes passwords and billing-provider ids).**

Who: the centre **owner** only (active owner of a centre). Staff, tutors, parents, other centres' owners, solo tutors and platform admins get nothing. Every export is audited (who, when, tables, row counts; never data). Where: Settings → Data export (`org?id=…#export`).

Format: one UTF-8 CSV per table (with a byte-order mark so Excel reads names correctly) plus `README.txt`, all in one ZIP built in the browser. Money columns ending `_cents` are whole cents and get a `_dollars` column next to them.

> This export contains families' names, phone numbers and email addresses (parents and guardians). That is personal data under the PDPA: store the file somewhere private, share it only with people who need it, and delete it when you no longer need it.

## Never exported

- Passwords, login tokens and anything from the login system.
- Login ids: every "who" column holds the person's name instead.
- Other centres' data: the export is for your centre only.
- Google calendar ids, mail-provider message ids and payment-proof file paths.
- Payout account numbers and holder names, unless the owner ticked "include full payout numbers" (masked as •••••1234 otherwise).
- **Invoice share links** (`centre_invoice_share`): Invoice share links. Anyone holding one link can read that invoice, so the links are never put in a file.
- **In-app notices** (`org_notifications`): In-app notices addressed to individual users. They are not business records and name login accounts.
- **Import bookkeeping** (`import_items`): The import's own bookkeeping (which row each imported line created, and a fingerprint of it) so that an import can be undone. Every row it points to is in its own file; the batch summaries are in import_batches.csv.
- **Statement fingerprints** (`statement_fingerprints`): Scrambled fingerprints of bank-statement lines, kept only so the same statement line is never matched twice. They hold no readable data; the matches themselves are in statement_matches.csv.
- **Billing-provider record** (`org_subscriptions`): TutorDeck's billing-provider record for the centre (Stripe customer and subscription ids). You can see these in your own Stripe account; the fee history is in the plan and monthly fee files.

## `centre_profile.csv` — Centre profile

The centre's own details: names, UEN, address, time zone and currency.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Your centre's id. |
| `trading_name` | Trading name. |
| `legal_name` | Registered (legal) name. |
| `uen` | Business registration number (UEN). |
| `address` | Address. |
| `kind` | Always "centre". |
| `preset` | The setup preset the centre started from. |
| `status` | setup, active or suspended. |
| `timezone` | The centre's time zone. |
| `currency` | Currency. |
| `reply_to_email` | Email address parents' replies go to. |
| `brand_color` | Brand colour on invoices and pages. |
| `created_at` | When the row was created (UTC). |

## `people_tutors_and_staff.csv` — Tutors, staff and parents with access

Everyone who has (or was invited to have) access to the centre: owner, staff admins, tutors and parent logins. No passwords and no login ids.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Unique id of this row. Other files point at it (for example a lesson's student_id is a student's id), so you can join files in a spreadsheet. For a tutor this is the id lessons and slots call taught_by. |
| `display_name` | Name shown in the app. |
| `role` | owner, staff, tutor or parent. |
| `permissions` | What a staff admin may do (separated by semicolons). |
| `employment_type` | For tutors: freelancer, part-time or full-time. |
| `status` | invited, active or disabled. |
| `invited_email` | The email address the invitation went to. |
| `phone` | Phone number, if one was entered. |
| `created_at` | When the row was created (UTC). |

## `tutor_payout_details.csv` — Tutor payout details

Where each tutor is paid. Account numbers and holder names are MASKED (•••••1234, first letter + •••) unless you ticked "include full payout numbers" before exporting. Only the current details, not history.

| `id` | Unique id of this row. Other files point at it (for example a lesson's student_id is a student's id), so you can join files in a spreadsheet. |
| `membership_id` | The tutor (people_tutors_and_staff.csv id). |
| `method` | bank, paynow_mobile or paynow_uen. |
| `bank_name` | Bank, for a bank account. |
| `paynow_id` | PayNow mobile number or UEN (masked unless you chose full numbers). |
| `account_no` | Bank account number (masked unless you chose full numbers). |
| `account_holder` | Name on the account (first letter only unless you chose full numbers). |
| `created_at` | When these details were saved (UTC). |
